title: Remove avoidable counting factors without changing trial support
statement: Admissible signed-area tilts reduce the walk recurrence to endpoint/last-direction states, O(M^3) positive arithmetic and O(M^2) storage per tilt, with actual signed powers retained. Physical square-dual traces overcount fixed diagonal resolutions without adding2^n labels. Dividing rooted activity by P and ordered tuples by j!, then paying3S boundary gate marks, retains each actual edge representation. Long-tail/source/target terms remain paid. This is the mathematical source of the marked exp(-6215) refinement.
